nodes.description: Immutable IERC20 stored on FundingLocker; the Liquidity Asset token held in escrow and used for all transfers.
Immutable address of the Loan contract; serves as the authorized caller in the isLoan modifier and as the recipient of drain().
constructor(address _liquidityAsset, address _loan) sets the immutable liquidityAsset and loan references.
isLoan modifier: require(msg.sender == loan, "FL:NOT_L") - access-control gate applied to pull() and drain().
pull(address dst, uint256 amt) external isLoan - transfers amt of Liquidity Asset to dst.
drain() external isLoan - reads full token balance of this contract and transfers it to the Loan.
msg.sender used in the isLoan modifier access-control check.
liquidityAsset.safeTransfer(dst, amt) inside pull(): external call to an arbitrary/attacker-supplied token contract with an attacker-supplied destination.
liquidityAsset.safeTransfer(loan, amt) inside drain(): external token call sending the escrowed balance out.
liquidityAsset.balanceOf(address(this)) inside drain(): external call to the token contract used to compute the transfer amount.
Constructor parameter _liquidityAsset cast to IERC20 and stored in liquidityAsset.
Constructor parameter _loan stored in the loan state variable used for authorization.
pull() parameter dst - destination address of the Liquidity Asset transfer.
pull() parameter amt - amount of Liquidity Asset to transfer.
Local variable amt in drain(): liquidityAsset.balanceOf(address(this)) result passed to safeTransfer.

edges.reason: _liquidityAsset constructor parameter is cast to IERC20 and stored in the liquidityAsset state variable.
_loan constructor parameter is stored as the loan address that later authorizes privileged calls.
Constructor assigns liquidityAsset = IERC20(_liquidityAsset).
Constructor assigns loan = _loan; this stored address is the sole trusted caller for isLoan.
msg.sender is compared against loan inside the isLoan modifier to gate privileged functions.
The loan state variable is read in the isLoan require to decide whether the caller is authorized.
isLoan modifier executes before pull(), restricting token transfers to the Loan.
isLoan modifier executes before drain(), restricting the full-balance sweep to the Loan.
dst is the destination parameter supplied by the caller of pull().
amt is the amount parameter supplied by the caller of pull().
pull() invokes liquidityAsset.safeTransfer(dst, amt).
dst parameter flows directly into the safeTransfer recipient argument.
amt parameter flows directly into the safeTransfer amount argument.
liquidityAsset provides the token contract on which safeTransfer is invoked.
safeTransfer performs an external call into the token contract, giving it control flow before pull() returns.
liquidityAsset provides the token contract on which balanceOf is called.
drain() performs the external liquidityAsset.balanceOf(address(this)) call.
The balanceOf return value is assigned to the local variable amt in drain().
drain() invokes liquidityAsset.safeTransfer(loan, amt).
safeTransfer makes an external call into the token contract, which regains control during drain() execution.
The locally computed balance amt is used as the transfer amount, so a reentrant token could distort the value being swept.
The loan state variable is the fixed recipient of the drained funds, linking authorization state to the transfer.

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor input parameter is only a temporary carrier for the value assigned to liquidityAsset; fold it into the constructor.
Constructor input parameter is only a temporary carrier for the value assigned to loan; fold it into the constructor.
pull() argument dst has no independent state; its semantics are entirely the pull() call interface.
pull() argument amt has no independent state; its semantics are entirely the pull() call interface.
Local amt exists only to carry the balanceOf result into the safeTransfer call inside drain().
